incident: From ScreenConnect to Hive Ransomware in 61 hours

sources.title: From ScreenConnect to Hive Ransomware in 61 hours - The DFIR Report (2023-09-25)
sources.what_it_gave: entry (document8765.exe -> ScreenConnect install), hops (remote services Atera/Splashtop on a server, wmiexec.py to other hosts, RDP to file shares/backups), cred access (Mimikatz on several servers), exfil (Rclone SFTP from file share server), impact (Hive manual on key servers + failed GPO scheduled task), TTR 61h

narrative_before: In an October 2022 intrusion the DFIR Report observed initial access via a trojanized executable (document8765.exe, loaded from environmentca[.]com per Huntress, likely email) installing ScreenConnect on the beachhead host (required local admin). ~1h in, discovery ran via ScreenConnect and a BITS transfer dropped a Cobalt Strike beacon; a trojanized ApacheBench (Metasploit shellcode) started a Meterpreter channel. The actors moved laterally with remote services to run PowerShell and MSI installers for Atera and Splashtop on a server, then used Impacket wmiexec.py to reach other hosts (quser checks, BITS CS). Next day Mimikatz was dropped and run remotely (wmiexec) on several servers. After an AD-data batch file, the actor RDPed to hosts, reviewed file shares and backups, dropped Rclone on a file-share server and exfiltrated its contents over SFTP, and ran netscan. ~3h after exfil they deployed Hive: they changed an admin password, manually ran the ransomware on several key servers, then staged the binary on a share and created a domain-wide GPO scheduled task - which had incorrect settings and failed. Key servers were encrypted manually; TTR was 61 hours.

detection_moments.description: ScreenConnect installed on the beachhead via document8765.exe; ~1h later discovery + BITS Cobalt Strike beacon + Meterpreter.
detection_moments.evidence: 'The execution of the file resulted in the installation of ScreenConnect ... run a BITS transfer job to deploy a Cobalt Strike beacon ... initiate a Meterpreter command and control channel' - From ScreenConnect to Hive, The DFIR Report

detection_moments.description: Lateral movement via remote services (Atera/Splashtop on a server) and Impacket wmiexec.py to other hosts; next-day Mimikatz on several servers.
detection_moments.evidence: 'lateral movement using remote services to execute PowerShell and MSI installers for Atera and Splashtop on a server ... lateral movement towards other hosts using Impacket's wmiexec.py ... dropped a Mimikatz binary on several servers' - From ScreenConnect to Hive

detection_moments.description: RDP to file shares and backups; Rclone exfil over SFTP from a file-share server; netscan with RDP focus.
detection_moments.evidence: 'dropped Rclone on a server with file shares and proceeded to configure a connection to a remote server over SFTP ... exfiltrate the file share's contents' - From ScreenConnect to Hive

detection_moments.description: ~3h after exfil: admin password changed, Hive run manually on key servers; domain-wide GPO scheduled task created but misconfigured and failed.
detection_moments.evidence: 'manually executed the ransomware on several key servers ... created a new domain-wide GPO with a scheduled task ... incorrect settings, resulting in a failed domain-wide ransomware deployment' - From ScreenConnect to Hive

attack_path: remote services install Atera/Splashtop on a server; Mimikatz (T1021.002/T1003.001)
Impacket wmiexec.py lateral movement to other hosts (T1047)
RDP to a file-share server; Rclone SFTP exfiltration (T1021.001/T1567.002)
Hive run manually on key servers; GPO scheduled task attempt from the DC (failed) (T1486/T1484.001)
ambiguities: Hosts named by role only; victim sector not stated. 'Several key servers' modelled as srv_1/srv_2.
Domain-wide deployment failed; only key servers successfully encrypted.
Moments are the report's own timeline markers, not a defender detection timeline.
